notes: Verbatim-EN-copy exemptions for check_android_strings.py. A translated pack entry whose value is identical to English is normally a gap (it hides the missing-translation report and blocks translators). These exact VALUES are legitimate exceptions because the German word IS the English word (loanwords, proper nouns, brand/provider names, unit labels, UI-neutral placeholders). 'shared' exempts the value in every locale; a locale key (e.g. 'de') exempts it only for that pack. Keep this list minimal: entries must be real words the target language uses, not laziness. See docs/local/UI_COPY_STYLE.md §8 and docs/LOCALIZATION.md.
